🚀 NEW on We ❤️ Open Source 🚀

Jay LaCroix of Learn Linux TV joins the We Love Open Source podcast to discuss read-only file systems, AI-assisted DevOps with human verification, and running tmux on a separate machine to preserve sessions through laptop reboots and failures.

He also shares his “reset time” habit for managing the demands of systems work.
